openings.claim: Replace magnetic dependence with positive boundaries: drilled steel strips mounted through existing carriage slots with M4 bolts contact nonworking margins; pivoting clamps prevent lift. Reserve two strips for releasable top clamps and two for lateral/longitudinal stops; cork pads protect contacts. Loosen/swing clamps by long ends, lift by unmarked margins, return against stops. Fabrication-and-test candidate; retention remains undemonstrated.
openings.discriminator: Compare engaged stops with the same clamps relying on cork friction, stops disengaged. Positive-stop responsibility predicts less displacement, particularly with the spare; both may pass through sufficient friction, establishing no stop benefit. Plate-strength differences need not affect mechanical boundaries; gloves may defeat sixty-second servicing. Supplied magnetic release forces (spare 3 N, original 7 N) establish no stroke-retention result.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, measure accessible-slot M4 compatibility and whether all four strips capture the plate outside the exposed working edge and full marked stroke clearance; reject incompatible layouts. At most two configurations, three twenty-stroke runs each: original once, spare twice, final run spare. Mark two nonworking references; measure displacement after every run for translation/rotation. Perform three timed glove removal/return checks per configuration; record edge contact and return position. Every displacement must remain within 1 mm and every service check within sixty seconds. Excess stop clearance, strip flexure, bolt loosening, lift escape or inaccessible clamp ends defeat the candidate.
openings.uncertainty: Unprovided slot dimensions, margin geometry, strip stiffness and clamp accessibility are indispensable. Verify fabrication within eighty minutes and observation within twenty; sufficiently quick assembly/glove operation cannot be assumed.

lineage.reason: Retains causal arrangement, rival, comparisons, defeat conditions, uncertain fit and resource caveats.

decision: Proceed only to geometry/time feasibility and bounded comparison in this synthetic task. Never drill, cut, heat or glue plate/carriage; drilling is for strips only. Keep marked 30 mm working edge exposed and untouched during service, added parts outside stroke clearance, carriage attached to rails. Use supplied resources; uncertain feasibility permits no constraint relaxation.
